name: ck-company-registry-reporting
description: Classify selected Cook Islands domestic company registry, records and financial statement duties using the Companies Act 2017 and current selected amendments. Use for new company registration prerequisites, local office and director evidence, annual return month, shareholder notice, audit eligibility or record retention questions in 2026. Includes mechanical thresholds, selected statutory fees, fictional worked cases, primary sources and reviewer checks. Holds legacy and overseas companies, beneficial ownership classification, incomplete calendars and other registration streams. This source-cited draft does not select an entity, complete a formation engagement or establish comprehensive country coverage.
